messi9Hours.habit: I never get less than 9 hours of sleep. My body needs it to recover.

ronaldo5Naps.habit: I take 5 short naps of 90 minutes instead of one long sleep. Recovery is everything.

haalandBedtime.habit: I go to bed at 10pm every night. No exceptions. Phone goes away at 9pm.

mbappeNoScreens.habit: No screens 1 hour before bed. The light ruins your sleep.

benzemaRoutine.habit: Same bedtime every night, even on weekends. Your body needs consistency.

sakaRest.habit: Sleep is when your muscles actually grow. I protect my sleep like I protect the ball.

viniJrRecovery.habit: After a big game, I sleep even more. Recovery is part of training.

messiPasta.habit: I eat pasta the night before every game. Carbs give you energy.

ronaldoNoSugar.habit: No sugar, no alcohol. I eat 6 small meals a day instead of 3 big ones.

haalandProtein.habit: I eat protein within 30 minutes after training. Helps muscles rebuild.

mbappeNoSoda.habit: I don't drink soda. Water and natural juice only.

pulisicGameDay.habit: Big breakfast, light lunch on game day. You want energy but not a full stomach.

pedriWater.habit: I drink water all day, not just when I'm thirsty. Stay ahead of thirst.

bellinghaamFuel.habit: Think of food as fuel. Would you put bad fuel in a Ferrari?

ronaldoExtra.habit: I stay 30 minutes after every practice. Extra work makes the difference.

messiWeakFoot.habit: I practice with my weak foot every day. Both feet should be weapons.

mbappeTired.habit: I do sprints when I'm tired, not when I'm fresh. That's when it counts.

haalandFinishing.habit: 100 shots after every training. Finishing is a skill you build.

salaahRepetition.habit: Repeat the same move 1000 times until your body does it without thinking.

debruyneVision.habit: I always know where my teammates are before I get the ball. Look around constantly.

neymarCreativity.habit: Practice tricks. Football should be fun. When you enjoy it, you play better.

messiSmallSteps.habit: Small improvements every day. You don't become great overnight.

ronaldoHardWork.habit: Hard work beats talent when talent doesn't work hard.

morganGoals.habit: I write down my goals every season. If you don't know where you're going, you won't get there.

rapinoeVisualize.habit: I visualize my best plays the night before a game. See it before you do it.

sonThankful.habit: I thank my teammates after every goal. Football is a team sport.

putellasBelieve.habit: Believe you belong on the field with anyone. Confidence is a choice.

modricNeverQuit.habit: The game is never over until the final whistle. Keep fighting.

rashfordMistakes.habit: Mistakes are lessons. Every time I fail, I learn something new.
